name: Annie Andrews
summary: Annie Elizabeth Andrews (née Lintzenich; born August 9, 1980) is an American pediatrician and politician who is a United States senator-elect from South Carolina. A member of the Democratic Party, she defeated Republican incumbent Darline Graham in the 2026 United States Senate election, in what was considered to be a major upset. Andrews is  the first woman elected to the Senate from South Carolina and the first Democrat to win a Senate election in South Carolina since 1998.
